rust_summary: entity model layers built in code (`native_layer_definitions`, NeoForge's `EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterLayerDefinitions`), baked with `native_bake_layer` and drawn with `native_draw_model_part`.
doc_summary: Entity model layers built in code, as vanilla's `LayerDefinition` builders build them (`MeshDefinition`, `CubeListBuilder`, `CubeDeformation`, `PartPose`): `native_layer_definitions(layers)` registers a mod's by id (`mymod:golem#main`, NeoForge's `EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterLayerDefinitions`), `native_bake_layer(layer)` bakes one of them or a vanilla layer (`minecraft:zombie#main`) into a `ModelPart` tree (`EntityModelSet.bakeLayer`), and `native_draw_model_part(draw, part, sprite, tint)` draws the tree, its parts posed as the mod set them, under a mob's or a block entity's frame (`ModelPart.render`). Bundles need "hooks": @API:model_layers@.
